source.name: NBA Communications (pr.nba.com): BAL and Rwanda Development Board multi-year extension
source.note: 'Visit Rwanda will continue to be showcased on BAL team uniforms and at the BAL Combine' - league-wide branding on all 12 teams' uniforms, not a club-level shirt deal.

source.name: BAL (bal.nba.com): BAL names PUMA as League's Official Outfitter ahead of 2026 season
source.quote: The Basketball Africa League (BAL) and PUMA, one of the world's leading sports brands, today announced a multiyear collaboration that makes PUMA the Official Outfitter of the BAL.
source.note: Kit maker, league-wide: the release says PUMA 'will supply all official BAL team, fan and referee apparel, including game uniforms' from the 2026 season, so ASC Ville de Dakar's 2026 uniform is PUMA-made. Not a club-level shirt slot; the league deal is also recorded as bal-puma.

source.name: Le Journal de Dakar: ASC Ville de Dakar – BAL : autorités et sponsors affichent leur soutien avant Rabat
source.quote: Nous sommes sponsors de presque toutes les Fédérations. C'est un honneur pour le Port de les accompagner. Particulièrement l'ASC Ville de Dakar.
source.note: Port Autonome de Dakar director general Waly Diouf Bodian at the club's send-off for the BAL Sahara Conference in Rabat; the mayor also lists 'le Port' among the club's sponsors. Documents the sponsorship, not a shirt placement.

source.name: KEBIMO SA (company site): KEBIMO SA, sponsor officiel de l'ASC Ville de Dakar
source.quote: KEBIMO SA confirme son engagement dans le développement du sport et de la jeunesse au Sénégal à travers son soutien renouvelé à l’ASC Ville de Dakar.
source.note: The sponsor's own page (undated; photos captioned 'KEBIMO SA, SPONSOR OFFICIEL DE L'ASC VILLE DE DAKAR'). Le Journal de Dakar (13 Apr 2026) reports FCFA 10m for 2026 plus FCFA 10m for the BAL campaign. Documents the sponsorship, not a shirt placement.

source.name: Le Journal de Dakar: ASC Ville de Dakar – BAL : autorités et sponsors affichent leur soutien avant Rabat
source.quote: Côté sponsors, il salue l'apport du Port, Kébimo et la Lonase
source.note: Dakar's mayor Abass Fall lists the Lonase among the club's sponsors days before the BAL Sahara Conference in Rabat. Documents the sponsorship, not a shirt placement.

summary: League branding only on the shirt itself: Visit Rwanda on all BAL uniforms and PUMA as the league-wide kit maker from 2026. The club's named 2026 sponsors — the state-owned Port Autonome de Dakar, the private builder Kébimo and the state lottery Lonase — are documented by named press and the company's site, but no shirt placement for them could be verified.
